fixes.title: Replace the h-independent stage-residual cap by an error-estimate-scaled forcing term (Eisenstat-Walker adapted to ROW stage solves)
fixes.summary: Today tau_i = eta*rhs_wrms = 0.1/||b||_1 = 0.02022 outer-WRMS units whenever rhs_wrms >= flow_wrms (g4_s5b0_inner_tolerance.rs:58-66), which is every stiff stage, so the admitted stage residual is constant in h and rtol and E-04 shows a fixed-h floor of 0.10-0.32 rtol on P1PR and 0.18-0.29 rtol in the adaptive P1 arms. The fix keeps the residual target absolute in outer-WRMS units (so GMRES stops on max(atol, rtol*||rhs||)=tau, gmres.rs:210, and the K-form rhs inflation of F-031 does not enter the accepted residual) but multiplies the cap by a forcing term derived from the embedded error of the last accepted step: tau_i = cap * min(1, err_ref*(h/h_ref)^(q+1))^alpha with alpha=(p+1)/(q+1)=6/5 for RODAS5P (p=5, q=4). Because err_ref ~ C h^5/rtol at fixed rtol, tau ~ h^6, so per-step contamination sum|b_i| ||W^-1|| tau is O(h^6) and global fixed-h order 5 is preserved down to the roundoff floor; in adaptive mode err_ref is O(1) so tau stays within a small factor of today's value and the cost profile is essentially unchanged. The reference (err_norm, h) of the previous accepted step is threaded through a new optional `InnerForcingReference` argument; with no history (step 0, fixed-step API without a carried reference) the rule degrades to the current cap, never to an abort.

fixes.title: Remove the step-0 abort: replace the 64-eps roundoff guard by a residual floor measured in the rhs scale plus a recorded flag, and let the embedded error estimate judge acceptance
fixes.summary: rodas5p_inner_forcing_target returns Err('roundoff floor exceeds the stage-residual heuristic allocation') when unclamped_eta < 64 eps and l1*tau > 0.1 (g4_s5b0_inner_tolerance.rs:67-76), i.e. whenever rhs_wrms > 0.1/(4.9455*64 eps) = 1.42e12, which E-04 hits at step 0 on P1 for rtol<=1e-8 (every h in 1/8..1/256) and on P1PR rtol=1e-10 for h>=1/32; the adaptive driver then records error=INFINITY and shrinks h by min_factor (integrate.rs:789-810, adaptive.rs:286-292) on a criterion that is not an accuracy failure. The guard compares an absolute residual floor (64 eps * rhs_wrms, which is exactly the backward-error level an LU solve also attains, and the direct arm integrates the same input to 1e-15) against an allocation that was never a proven error bound (code comment lines 12-17). The fix: never Err on this condition; compute floor = max(64 eps, 64 eps * max(rhs_wrms, flow_wrms)), set tau = max(tau_wanted, floor), record floor_active in StageInnerForcingReport and a new WorkCounters field inner_forcing_floor_hits, and rely on the existing embedded error check (finish_step, sequential.rs:583-586, which does see the stage contamination through btilde.K) to reject the step if the contamination is real. The residual_norm > tau check at sequential.rs:507-513 stays as the hard contract.

fixes.title: K-form vs U-form residual scaling: keep the certified K-form stage equations now, express every relative inner criterion against a solution-scale reference, and schedule the U-form as a separate lane
fixes.summary: The K-form rhs_i = h f_i + h J sum_j gamma_ij K_j + h^2 gamma_i f_t (sequential.rs:359-364) has WRMS norm ~|h lambda| |K_i| on stiff modes (E-04: rhs_wrms/flow_wrms = 40 at h=1/8 on P1PR, rhs_wrms up to 5e11), so any criterion stated as a fraction of ||rhs|| (the fixed-eta GMRES arms with C_eta ~1e2-1e3, the eta = 64 eps floor test) becomes an absolute stage error inflated by |h lambda|. Because the forcing lane already passes an absolute tau through residual_scale and GMRES stops on max(atol, rtol*||rhs||) = tau, the inflation reaches the accepted residual only through the floor test (fixed by G2-2) and through the reported eta (which the test at inner_forcing_v2_contracts.rs:66 wrongly certifies as increasing when h shrinks). Decision: do not rewrite the stage formulation inside this fix group; instead (a) make tau absolute and error-scaled (G2-1), (b) define the achievable-residual floor in the rhs scale (G2-2), (c) report a solution-relative diagnostic rho_i = achieved_residual_wrms / max(flow_wrms, ||K_i||_WRMS) in StageInnerForcingReport so receipts show the residual against the stage-increment scale, and (d) open a separate U-form lane (Hairer-Wanner IV.7 transformed variables U_i = sum_j gamma_ij K_j, W' = (1/(h gamma)) I - J, no J*gmix on the rhs, one JVP per stage fewer) with its own certificate replay, since it changes every certified coefficient path, dense output and the embedded estimate.
